notes.title: Love is Dead update, v1.1.1.0
notes.content:
Hi folks! Some patch notes from our latest Love is Dead update, version 1.1.1.0
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where, after restarting via the Pause menu, pressing Space/Select at any point would restart the level again
[*]Added new SFX, and adjusted volume levels of some existing SFX (notably the convert-human-to-zombie sound)
[*]Performance updates, things are running smoother than ever now
[*]Additional small fixes and improvements
[/list]
These last couple weeks have been buck wild, thank you SO MUCH to everyone who played the game, reviewed it, and let me know how your experience was. There'll be plenty more updates for Love is Dead over the coming months :)

Cheers!

-Nick Yonge
Curiobot
